race_number: Protestor: International Jury Protestee: Roman Hagara (AUT) (), AUT 97
procedural_matters: AUT 97 did not attend the hearing. The hearing proceeded under 63.1(b).
The hearing panel was composed under rule N1.4(b)
facts: Roman Hagara (AUT) works for the Austrian Sailing Federation.
He has been on the water for 7 July and 8 July evaluating the performance of the AUT coach.
Roman Hagara is not coaching AUT 97.
The AUT coach has paid the required fees.
No additional fee has been paid for Roman Hagara.
conclusions: NOR/SI 4.1 requires a "Official Support fee: 100 Euro per supporter".
The Jury interprets the word "supporter" to mean a support person as defined in the RRS.
As Roman Hagara is not providing physical or advisory support to a competitor, he is not a support person as defined.
The Jury has warned Roman Hagara that if he engages in any support to AUT 97 itself, he must pay the €100 fee.
